summary: Replaces channels from the first input with matching channels from the second input and passes unmatched first-input channels through.

key_params.name: length
key_params.note: Choose output range from first input or second input

key_concepts: Replace CHOP replaces first-input channels with same-named channels from the second input.
Channels present in the first input but missing from the second input pass through unchanged.
The operator can act as a fast delete workflow by sending all channels to input 2 and only kept channels to input 1.
Length chooses whether the first or second input range defines the output interval.
Notify on Change is a diagnostic for input-name changes and is not part of the replacement logic.
common_gotchas: Replacement is name-based: only matching channels from the second input replace first-input channels.
Unmatched first-input channels are passed through unchanged.
It can delete channels quickly by sending all channels to input 2 and only kept channels to input 1.
Length selection controls whether the first or second input interval defines the output range.
Notify on Change is a diagnostic and can add overhead in busy patching workflows.
